title: NIST WebBook: Iron is Fe, molecular weight 55.845 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Iron as Fe, molecular weight 55.845 amu, CAS 7439-89-6.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Iron, CAS Registry Number 7439-89-6, lists molecular formula Fe and molecular weight 55.845 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 55.9349375 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Fe. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
